name: LeeAnne Lynch
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Decatur, Georgia
education: Georgia State University College of Law
about: Leeanne Lynch is a partner at The Lynch Law Group in Decatur, Georgia. She has over 13 years of experience practicing law, and she represents clients with criminal defense matters, including felony crimes, misdemeanor crimes, probation violations, juvenile crimes, bond bail hearings, illegal search and seizure and so on.

Ms. Lynch has gained a reputation for her dedication and fierce advocacy. She zealously fights for the rights of her clients who are accused of wrongdoing. She provides knowledgeable and sound counsel to her clients with an unwavering commitment to their needs.

With a degree in social relations, Ms. Lynch graduated from the Michigan State University James Madison College of Social Relations and Policy. She obtained her Juris Doctor from the Georgia State University College of Law.

While in law school, Ms. Lynch was selected to be the president of the Student Bar Association for two consecutive years. She was the recipient of the Georgia Association for Women Lawyers Outstanding Law Student Award.

Ms. Lynch completed a trial advocacy program, the William W. “Bill” Daniel Trial Advocacy Program, from the Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, where she gained invaluable experience through intense training and review by criminal defense attorneys. Ms. Lynch has lectured at several prominent platforms and continuing legal programs.

Ms. Lynch has memberships in The Joseph Henry Lumpkin American Inn of Court, the Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. Ms. Lynch is admitted to practice before the Superior Courts of Georgia, the Georgia Court of Appeals and the Supreme Court of Georgia.

Honored for her remarkable service, Ms. Lynch has an AV Preeminent* peer review rating from Martindale Hubbell and has a 10.0 rating from Avvo. She has been awarded by Dekalb County for completing 10 years of exceptional and distinguished service. Ms. Lynch has numerous testimonials from satisfied clients and endorsements from peers.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
